title: The Duke's Cure
text:
*With the physician dealt with, you turn your attention to the Duke. Brother Orin — if you found him — has provided an antidote. If not, simply stopping the poison will have to do.*

*Hours pass. Thomas watches over his lord while you guard the door. Then — a hoarse voice from the bed.*

Duke Aldren: "Water... I need water. Not wine. Water."

*The Duke's eyes are clearer than they've been in weeks. He sits up — slowly, painfully — and looks around his chamber as if seeing it for the first time.*

Duke Aldren: "How long have I been... like this? Thomas — what has happened to my city?"

*Thomas tells him everything. The Duke's expression shifts from confusion to horror to cold, royal fury.*

Duke Aldren: "Goran. Harren. They will answer for this. All of them will answer for this."

choices.text: "Your Grace, we need your authority. Issue orders to the loyal guards."
"Rest, Your Grace. We'll handle Harren. Just give us your seal."
